order: Draw up the order and executor report for the cross-vendor gate re-review of the round-2 diff. Pin the review to the commit range spanning the initial round and the round-2 fixes, and route it through the cross-vendor review lane rather than the standard delta lane used for later rounds. Scope the audit strictly to what changed in that diff. State plainly, as its own line, that the verdict on this exact pin decides whether the pending work orders clear revise status — the outcome is binary, and no partial or conditional reading of the diff may substitute for that single decision, since this is the gate review the earlier rounds were building toward. Add only the order and the executor report as new files under roster/: touch no existing roster record, and leave every prior round's file byte-unchanged, since this pass creates the gate's own paper trail rather than editing anyone else's.
claims: We produced the order and executor report for the cross-vendor gate re-review, pinning it to the commit range between the initial round and the round-2 fixes and routing it through the cross-vendor review lane. The two files add 136 lines with zero deletions: 65 for the order and 71 for the executor report, so no existing roster file was touched. The order states that this verdict alone decides whether the pending work orders clear revise status.
